data.name: Arjith
data.gender_notes: Arjith is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arjith means resolute, valiant. This powerful name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is associated with the Hindu epic Mahabharata. Arjith was the name of one of the greatest warriors in Indian mythology, Arjuna, who was the charioteer of Lord Krishna and a central character in the Bhagavad Gita. The name Arjith carries the meaning “Resolute, Valiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arjith usually hope their child will grow to embody resolute, valiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Arjith belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Resolute, Valiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arjith total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

He is known for his unwavering devotion and commitment to his duty as a warrior and as a disciple. The name embodies courage, determination, and loyalty, making it a powerful and meaningful moniker in Hindu culture. It serves as a reminder of the importance of staying true to one's values and following the path of righteousness, which are integral aspects of Hindu philosophy.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name Arjith holds great significance as it is associated with the character Arjuna in the Bhagavad Gita. Arjuna's quest for knowledge and understanding led him to seek guidance from Lord Krishna, ultimately leading to the teaching of the Bhagavad Gita. The name Arjith is a reflection of Arjuna's unwavering spirit and resilience, illustrating the importance of maintaining a steady mind and focus on spiritual growth. It is a reminder that no matter the obstacles, the path to enlightenment and self-realization must be pursued with unwavering determination and courage.

historical_references.reference: Arjuna, also known as Arjith, was a central character in the Indian epic Mahabharata. He was a great warrior and a key member of the Pandava dynasty. Arjuna's most notable achievement was his role in the Kurukshetra War, where he was mentored by the god Bhagavad Gita.

Arjuna, or Arjith, was a prince of the Kuru kingdom in ancient India. He was the second of five brothers, the sons of King Indra and Princess Subhadra. Arjuna is also known for his loyalty to Krishna, whom he considered to be his friend and mentor. He was a great archer and a valiant warrior, and his story is recounted in various Hindu texts, including the Mahabharata.
